template.name: Android · App
template.description: Android app with Kotlin or Java, Gradle and Material 3 — single activity, drawer or foundations only.
param.appName.label: App name
param.appName.help: Name shown in the Android launcher
param.packageName.label: Package name
param.packageName.help: Application package, follows the app name (e.g. com.example.myapp)
param.projectType.label: Project type
param.projectType.help: Starting screen: single activity, foundations without any activity, or activity with a navigation drawer
param.language.label: Language
param.language.help: Kotlin (recommended) or Java for the app code
param.minSdk.label: Min SDK
param.minSdk.help: Minimum Android version (API 24 = Android 7.0, floor of recent libraries)
param.includeTests.label: Unit tests
param.includeTests.help: Adds a GreeterTest and an ExampleUnitTest
param.includeWrapper.label: Gradle Wrapper
main.kdoc: Main activity: displays a welcome message via Greeter.
main.tiroir.kdoc: Main activity: toolbar, navigation drawer and home fragment.
main.navigation.kdoc: Main activity: host of the NavHostFragment — the navigation graph drives the screens.
fragment.kdoc: Home fragment: shows the greeting or the about text depending on the selected space.
bienvenue.kdoc: Welcome screen: first destination of the navigation graph.
greeter.kdoc: Greets people — the testable core of the example.
greeter.greet.kdoc: Greets a name, or the whole world when the name is blank.
test.name: Edsger
test.example.kdoc: Checks that the unit test harness works (trivial addition).
proguard.entete: ProGuard/R8 rules of the :app module — applied to release builds.
proguard.conserver: Keep a class and its members (uncomment and adapt):
proguard.nePasAvertir: Silence a library's warnings (uncomment and adapt):
readme.apk: The debug APK is produced in app/build/outputs/apk/debug/.
readme.variante.vide: Single-activity variant: one `MainActivity` and its layout.
readme.variante.sansactivite: No-activity variant: Android foundations without any screen — no `MainActivity` is generated.
readme.variante.tiroir: Drawer variant: `MainActivity` with toolbar, `FragmentAccueil` and a Material navigation drawer.
readme.navigation: With Navigation: destinations live in `res/navigation/graphe_principal.xml` — in the single-activity variant the home screen is `BienvenueFragment`; in the drawer variant the menu and the graph share the same identifiers.
readme.dep.retrofit: Retrofit — HTTP client with Gson converter
readme.dep.hilt: Hilt — dependency injection (see the Application class)
apropos.texte: Application generated by CodeIDE — explore the navigation drawer!
param.applicationId.label: Application ID
param.applicationId.help: Unique Android identifier (Play Store), follows the package name by default
param.targetSdk.label: Target SDK
param.targetSdk.help: Targeted Android version (34-36; 36 = latest, required to publish on Play Store)
param.includeCoroutines.label: Kotlin Coroutines
param.includeRetrofit.label: Retrofit
param.includeRetrofit.help: Adds Retrofit 3 with its Gson converter for HTTP calls
param.includeRetrofit.raison: Retrofit requires a screen: pick an activity (empty or drawer).
param.includeNavigation.label: Navigation
param.includeNavigation.raison: Navigation requires a screen: pick an activity (empty or drawer).
param.includeRoom.label: Room
param.includeRoom.help: Adds Room (SQLite, KSP) with a ready-to-use sample database
param.includeHilt.label: Hilt
param.includeHilt.help: Adds Hilt dependency injection (Dagger, KSP) with the Application class
application.kdoc: Hilt entry point: enables dependency injection across the app.
dao.compter.kdoc: Counts the tasks (query validated by Room at compile time).
base.kdoc: Room database: version 1, plan migrations beyond that.
hint.retrofit.sans.coroutines: Retrofit without Coroutines: blocking calls require a dedicated executor — consider enabling Coroutines.
hint.room.sans.hilt: Room without Hilt: the database is instantiated manually (see `BddLocale.creer`) — Hilt is recommended for injection.
regle.minSdk.sup.targetSdk: The minimum SDK exceeds the target SDK — lower minSdk or raise targetSdk.
regle.targetSdk.sup.plateforme: The target SDK exceeds the generator's major platform (36).
preset.app-complete.description: Drawer, Navigation, Room and Hilt — Coroutines included for async work.
